caption: The drawing features a central object resembling a decorative stand or finial, which has a large upright triangular frame bordered with a yellow, red, and green color scheme. The frame is lined with small, rectangular brick-red projections. The triangle is supported by a column with vertical orange, yellow, green, and blue accents. The base of the column splits into three arched, green legs with decorative dots at the top where the legs meet the column. To the right of the main object, there are five separate technical illustrations of component parts: four of them are reddish-brown metal pieces of different shapes (clamp, rectangular and L-shaped brackets, ornamental top), and one is a non-figurative ornament. Below the main object, there is a circle with a yellow-gold border and a brownish central square, and to the lower right side, there is a top-down view of the stand showing the intersection of the three green legs with a central yellow and brown medallion. The drawing is set on an off-white background, with the word "Willoughby" on the lower right.
title: Tenebrae Candelabra
